title: Design: Payer's Invoices tab shows the Service For column after No.
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A and customers B and C.
  • Have two new open invoices for this test billed to customer A: one for customer B's work, one for customer C's.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p5-02-after-a-j-invoices.png, bt-p5-01-before-a-j-invoices.png, bt-p5-04-after-valders-open-only-off.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click the Invoices tab.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page opens.

Step 2:

  • The columns read Date, Type, No., Service For, Memo, Total, Balance, Status, Action.
  • The Service For cells name customer B and customer C in plain black text (not links).

Step 3:

  • The Service For text stays on one line and does not overlap Memo.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R6: “The Bill To's Invoices tab shows a "Service For" column naming the customer the work was for.”
  • S10-R1: “The invoice's receivable posts to the Bill To's account, on its Invoices tab, AR Aging and statements.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
